title: How often the declared target's pair is actually there, and what Claim 3 looks like on each side of that
cost: offline, $0. Reads M54's ShapeKnots cache and M55's record cache. No folding is run.
why: Definition 1 clause (iii) requires the intervened pair to be in the DECLARED target. Nothing
in the manuscript says how often the molecule agrees. That number is the upper bound on the
criterion's validity and the paper does not currently carry it.
M54 measured 0.7948 of intervened pairs present in the built probing reference, but only as a
descriptive line inside the depth arm, and only for intervened pairs. Two things are missing:
the same fraction over ALL declared-target pairs in admitted designs, which is what clause
(iii) actually quantifies over, and what the paper's results look like split on it.
Splitting Claim 3 on confirmation is the arm with real direction risk. If the free integer
beats the predictors on both sides, Claim 3 is more robust and more ordinary. If it beats
them only where the probing reference confirms the pair, Claim 3 becomes a sharper positive
statement with a stated domain. Both are results; neither is a repair.

A1_clause_iii_validity: Over the admitted design cells, the fraction of DECLARED-TARGET pairs that the built probing
reference also calls paired -- reported over all declared pairs, and separately over the
subset that carries an admitted intervention, because those are different populations and
the manuscript would otherwise quote one for the other.
Reported with its across-design spread, not as a point alone.
A2_claim3_stratified: The Claim 3 comparison -- free helix depth against each predictor's level arm -- computed
separately on interventions whose pair the built reference confirms and on those it does
not, with a paired interval on the difference between the two strata.
A3_depth_is_not_just_confirmation: Whether depth's advantage is only a proxy for being confirmed: the level arm of the binary
confirmation indicator itself, scored the same way, and depth's arm holding it fixed.

V_before_any_arm.V1_zero_point: a pair set scored against itself confirms at 1.0; against the empty structure at 0.0
V_before_any_arm.V2_reproduces_M54: the confirmed fraction over intervened pairs must reproduce M54's 0.7948 to better than 5e-5, read from the artifact
V_before_any_arm.V3_reverse_control: this file's level arms must reproduce the four published values (+0.32947, +0.25570, +0.27649, +0.32252) to better than 5e-5
V_before_any_arm.V4_strata_partition: the two strata must be disjoint and must sum to the full 4317 interventions
V_before_any_arm.V5_equivalent_form: pooling the two strata back with their own weights must return the unstratified level arm to better than 1e-9

K_void_conditions.K1: either stratum holds fewer than 200 interventions -> the split is not reportable and the run says so instead of reporting an interval

stakes.S1: the clause (iii) confirmation fraction over all declared-target pairs is at least 0.50 -- below that, the criterion admits mostly pairs the molecule does not make, and the manuscript must say so in the Limitations rather than in a footnote
stakes.S2: free depth beats every predictor's level arm in the CONFIRMED stratum
stakes.S3: free depth beats every predictor's level arm in the UNCONFIRMED stratum too
stakes.S4: the confirmation indicator's own level arm is smaller than depth's -- depth is not merely reporting whether the pair is real

declared_consequences.W1_if_S1_fails: clause (iii)'s validity bound goes into the Limitations as a headline sentence, and every agreement number scored against the declared target is labelled with it.
declared_consequences.W2_if_S3_fails: Claim 3 gains a stated domain: the free integer wins where the probing data confirms the pair, and the claim is narrowed to that stratum in the abstract and the claim box.
declared_consequences.W3_if_S4_fails: the free-integer result is restated as 'a free integer that encodes whether the declared pair is real', which is a weaker and more mechanical claim, and the abstract says so.
declared_consequences.W4_regardless: the clause (iii) number is printed beside Definition 1, whichever way it falls.

verdict_rule: count the stakes met out of four and name the verdict; arms are read only after every V check has passed
